hypothesis: Frozen original four-block reference representations may destroy or fail to address causal raw action/effect correspondences before the final readout; diagnose separate addressability, effect-value recoverability, and linear-readout accessibility without changing the original model.

source.generation: Same P73-style general synthetic source family but fresh independent source seeds: per-world random orthogonal 16D target action keys, independent tanh 16D consequences, repeated targets twice and 8 singleton random distractor actions/effects, uniformly permuted factual order, a final executed simulated query on one target action. Input history is action16+observed effect16; query input is action16+zeros16; expected effect withheld until scoring.
source.locality: All worlds FIT/VAL newly generated; never use P65-P73 consumed eval data or regenerate earlier source as novel. No OOD generation/scoring in P74.
source.audit: For each FIT and VAL: 4-bin role deviation <=0.05; held-out index-only balanced accuracy <=0.55; no future query, role, or final outcome included in factual input; source SHA and exactly 24 factual events checked.

models.native_reference: Exact unchanged model.HybridPilot(32,16,Configuration(width=16,heads=2,ssm=True,attention=True,ttt=True,depth=True)), all weights random seed [740201,740203,740207], eval() for frozen-feature probes.
models.raw_nearest: For each final action, normalize raw factual 16D keys; choose highest raw key cosine, return that historical actually observed 16D consequence. No relevance flags, labels, future effects or role at readout.
models.projected_address: Run original frozen stem->diagonal SSM->causal attention over 24 factual events plus final query; collect factual normalized TTT key outputs, final normalized TTT query output; argmax projected cosine over histories, then output the historically observed consequence of chosen event. No evaluator role in decision.
models.values: Use original frozen TTT tanh value projection from pre-TTT causal factual representation. FIT supervised linear ridge maps 16D native value features to their own actually observed factual consequences. VAL tests the decoder on held-out worlds; query retrieval with RAW keys and native-decoded values isolates value sufficiency.
models.native_readout: For original model query, capture 16D post-depth representation at the last step with factual TTT writes and read-before-write final query. Freeze whole original core. FIT ridge maps 17D [representation,1] to observed final consequence; VAL measures whether a new linear readout can recover consequence without changing any other weights.
models.oracle_readout: FIT/VAL ridge 17D [raw-nearest retrieved observed consequence,1] to true consequence, reporting linear head capacity when valid associative feature is provided; diagnostic only, not eligible baseline comparison.
models.negative_credit: On negative worlds, shuffle historical observed effects independently from historical keys, leave final query true consequence unchanged; raw-nearest MSE must worsen at least 10x against unshuffled negative-world raw-nearest MSE.
models.gradient: On a small FIT batch, original random model native query MSE backward; report gradient norms or None independently for stem, ssm.delta, attn.qkv, ttt.key, ttt.value, ttt.query, ttt.proj, depth.router, head. Require finite non-None gradients for stem, attention, TTT key/query/value and head; depth router None is admissible and reported, not silently scored PASS.

training.full_native_training: NONE; P73 full-hybrid trained result remains a separate negative, no claim of this random probe measuring trained checkpoint.
training.ridge_formula: Deterministic CPU float64 ridge (X^TX + 1e-2 I)^{-1}X^TY, final intercept unregularized; FIT-only, no validation-selected hyperparameters; widths 16+1 to outputs 16.
training.distinct_core_init: Hash exact model.state_dict weights; verify three different seeds; model parameters unchanged after probe
training.full_procedure: One FIT+VAL pass per core initialization, no OOD or science source reuse.

frozen_thresholds.source_invalid: Any leakage/position/preprocessing or SHA failure stops scoring and is DEV_FAIL_SOURCE.
frozen_thresholds.raw_competent: RAW-key nearest hit@1 >=0.99, and raw direct readout VAL MSE<=0.001; otherwise source baseline incompetent and block localization.
frozen_thresholds.addressable: Native projected TTT query-to-key top1 hit fraction>=0.70 AND VAL MSE with native address + raw historical values <=0.60*VAL zero-state error. Failing indicates native *untrained* address representation insufficient; not which learned block would repair it.
frozen_thresholds.value_decodable: Native TTT projected factual values followed by FIT-only ridge reconstruct heldout VAL factual effect MSE<=0.60*VAL zero-state MSE. This tests linear recoverability, not causal retention; if fails, value representation insufficient under fixed linear decoder.
frozen_thresholds.readout_decodable: FIT-only ridge on original full native query features achieves VAL MSE<=0.85*zero-state; failing means complete frozen native features insufficient for a linear readout, not proof head optimizer is defective.
frozen_thresholds.oracle_head_control: FIT-only ridge on correct raw retrieved consequences achieves VAL MSE<=0.01; otherwise protocol invalid.
frozen_thresholds.causal_negative: Shuffled wrong credit raw key readout MSE on negative worlds >=10*clean raw key readout MSE, requiring clean MSE<=1e-5; using max(clean,0.00001) as denominator avoids division by zero.
frozen_thresholds.interpretation: Only claim a compartment-specific DEV diagnostic where that control independently fails/passes. No P74 SCIENTIFIC_PASS, superior hybrid claim, or training-path root-cause assertion from frozen random core.
frozen_thresholds.stop: On fail report negative faithfully, no postresult edits to these source rules; unrecognized limits = UNVERIFIED.

guardrails: No original model or controller modification
No paid API, no physical actuation
No model training or first-use protected experiment
No incompatible PR merging or promotion
